captions.text: Hey, welcome back!
In this video, we will tackle Link Vault mindset
and how to make the most out of it.
Your affiliate link is the coupon with your name
on it.
If the code is wrong, you did the work and somebody
else gets the credit.
Link Vault is where Wi -Fi system stores those
coupons, so Gold Rush always arms comments with
the right URL.
This is beliefs before buttons, so when you save
links, you save trust.
Quick picture.
You already ran Gold Rush at least once.
If you did not, go ahead and watch the previous
videos.
You will get a step -by -step guide on how to do
it, so let us continue.
On Gold Rush, you can paste your affiliate link
every time or save to your links so it lands in
Link Vault.
The sidebar label is Link Vault under Library,
Saved Affiliate Links.
In training, say Link Vault allowed.
The Gold Rush button still says Save to Your Links
because that is the action on that screen.
Belief 1.
Naming is caring for future you.
Offer names should read like a product on a shelf.
Ultimate weight loss system, not Link 3.
Niche or category helps when you promote multiple
offers in one vertical.
Weight loss, make money, dating.
Notes are for commission rate, audience, where
it converts, not a life story.
Future you picks from a list in Gold Rush.
Messy names become misclicks.
Belief 2.
One canonical link per offer beats five almost
the same hops.
Vendors sometimes give multiple tracking URLs.
Pick one primary hop, save it in Link Vault, and
use it until the vendor replaces it.
Testing different links is valid.
Save them as different offer names so you know
which ticket you are posting.
Never paste a broken or incomplete URL.
Invalid at save time is cheaper than invalid inside
50 live comments.
Belief 3.
Link Vault is set up, not traffic.
Saving links does not send clicks by itself.
It removes friction before Gold Rush.
Think Wallet of Tickets.
You choose the ticket once, Gold Rush prints comments
with that ticket inside.
My Vault stores the printed stack.
You post on shorts.
Skipping Link Vault is not fatal.
Paste works, but operators with three or more offers
almost always save first because repasting is where
typos hide.
Belief 4.
Edit beats delete and hope.
Vendor changed your hop?
Open the card, edit, update your affiliate link,
save changes.
Old comment packs in My Vault still carry the old
URL from Generation Day.
Regenerate packs after a link swap if that offer
is still active.
Delete removes the link from Link Vault and Gold
Rush will not offer it in the saved picker anymore.
Only delete dead offers or duplicates you created
by mistake.
Belief 5.
Organization is targeting.
Tips on the page say, organize by niche, test multiple
offers, track clicks if you use a shortener, aim
higher ticket when it fits your audience.
You do not need every tip day one, but match links
to niches is the spine.
Weight loss link on weight loss shorts.
Make money link on side hustle shorts.
Mismatch gets views.
Mismatch rarely gets buyers.
Belief 6.
Your link is public the moment it is in a YouTube
comment.
Treat it like cash.
Do not share your Link Vault screen and screenshots
with full URLs if you worry about bad actors.
Normal affiliate hygiene.
Do not save links to offers you have not read.
Refund rates hurt accounts, not just vibes.
Promote what you would tell your sister about.
Or do not promote it.
Belief 7.
Empty Link Vault is a choice, not a failure.
No affiliate links yet walks you through save a
money link, name the offer, drop it in comments.
If you are one -off testing Gold Rush, paste once
and save later.
If you are building a catalog, save first every
time you commit to an offer for the week.
Emotional stakes.
Plain version.
One correct link in Link Vault means every comment
Gold Rush writes carries your commission ID.
One typo means you become unpaid marketing for
the vendor.
Link Vault mindset is boring on purpose.
Boring accuracy makes exciting paydays possible
later.
Treat every saved hop like a paycheck envelope
with your name on the flap.
Three habits before the click -by -click Link Vault
training.
Habit one.
When you click save to your links on Gold Rush,
open Link Vault within a day and confirm the card
looks right.
Name, niche, URL tail.
Habit two.
One notes line on your best offer.
Converts on shorts or main hop.
So six months from now, you remember why you kept
it.
Habit three.
Before any premium tool later in academy, pick
your Link Vault winner.
Premium kits reuse the same tickets.
Your action.
If you have not saved a link yet, grab your best
HTTPS affiliate hop, open Link Vault from Library,
and add it with a human offer name before the next
video.
If you already saved from Gold Rush, open Link
Vault and read the three use steps.
Copy or pick, generate comments, post, post, and
earn, out loud once.
Sounds silly.
Locks the model in your head.
I'll see you in the next one.
